goals.text: An operator or agent releases kmctl or kmaudit by naming the package, and every release goes out with notes that were reviewed before merge and checked after publish
The always-loaded release rule and the skill do not repeat each other, and the skill stays true to the workflows it drives

outcomes.change: `/release <kmctl|kmaudit>` walks the dry run, the real run, the notes review in the version pull request and the published-notes check
outcomes.checked_by: `new:tests/test_release_skill.py` (front matter names `release`; every `-f KEY=` is a `release.yml` input; package values match the input's options; cited paths exist, `<tag>`/`<package>` placeholders matched as globs; `-k explains` tests for the two-workflow and version-source explanations; the after-merge step watches the release-tag run with `gh run watch`/`gh run view` and reads its `::warning::`/step summary of late commits; the gap step edits both the Release and the committed notes file and never regenerates), and a manual `/release kmaudit` dry run

outcomes.change: `releases.md` keeps only the no-`--admin` rule and `every-release-has-notes`, reworded so notes are reviewed in the pull request and a gap after publish is added by hand to the Release and the committed notes file, never regenerated, and points at the skill
outcomes.checked_by: `tests/test_rules.py` (cited paths exist, cited ADRs exist) and `new:tests/test_release_skill.py` `-k rule` (the rule names the skill's folder `.claude/skills/release/`, names `gh release edit` and the committed notes file, and does not say to regenerate published notes)

outcomes.change: A test pins the repo-local release skill to `release.yml`'s inputs and the files it cites
outcomes.checked_by: the test fails on a copy of the skill with a made-up `-f` input or a missing path, and passes on the real one

problems.text: No skill walks a release: the flow lives as prose in `.claude/rules/releases.md`, assumes one package, never says why `release.yml` and `release-tag.yml` are separate or why `apm/apm.yml` is kmctl's version source, and nothing reads release-tag's run for late commits missing from the notes

`.claude/rules/releases.md` will describe a stale one-package flow once releases take a package and the notes are committed in the version pull request, its after-publish fix (regenerate the notes from the script) would overwrite the reviewed notes, and it would repeat the skill's steps
No test reads `.claude/skills/`, so a repo-local skill that names a renamed workflow input or a moved file goes stale silently
